2.title: Stored observations
2.sql: SELECT sum(n) AS observations FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT count(*) AS n FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts))

3.title: Peak precipitation rate
3.sql: SELECT max(rain_mm_h) AS peak FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts)

4.title: Coldest infrared pixel
4.sql: SELECT min(brightness_k) AS coldest FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts)

5.title: Rainy cells · snapshot
5.sql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN rain_mm_h >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(rain_mm_h),0) AS rainy FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP)

6.title: PRECIPITATION  /  0.5° cell maxima
6.sql: SELECT floor(latitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS latitude, floor(longitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS longitude, max(rain_mm_h) AS rain_mm_h FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY floor(latitude * 2), floor(longitude * 2)

7.title: INFRARED  /  0.5° cell means
7.sql: SELECT floor(latitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS latitude, floor(longitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS longitude, avg(brightness_k) AS brightness_k FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY floor(latitude * 2), floor(longitude * 2)

8.title: Rainfall envelope · every 15 minutes
8.sql: SELECT ts AS time, avg(rain_mm_h) AS mean_rate, max(rain_mm_h) AS peak_rate FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

9.title: Cloud temperature envelope · hourly
9.sql: SELECT ts AS time, min(brightness_k) AS coldest, avg(brightness_k) AS mean_brightness FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

10.title: Rainfall within ${radius} km of the selected center
10.sql: SELECT ts AS time, avg(rain_mm_h) AS local_mean, max(rain_mm_h) AS local_peak FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND st_distance_sphere_m(wkt_point_from_latlng(latitude,longitude), wkt_point_from_latlng(${center_lat},${center_lon})) <= ${radius} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

11.title: Rain hotspots × satellite observations
11.sql:
SELECT p.latitude, p.longitude, p.rain_mm_h, s.brightness_k,
round(st_distance_sphere_m(wkt_point_from_latlng(p.latitude,p.longitude),wkt_point_from_latlng(${center_lat},${center_lon}))/1000,1) AS distance_km
FROM pardig p JOIN satweave s ON p.region_id=s.region_id AND p.grid_id=s.grid_id AND p.ts=s.ts
WHERE p.region_id=${region:sqlstring} AND s.region_id=${region:sqlstring}
AND p.ts=CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) AND s.ts=CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY p.rain_mm_h DESC, p.grid_id LIMIT 15
